chunks: From him, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ma'alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Wassash, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The habitual drinker of wine will meet Allah, Exalted and Glorious, on the day he meets Him as a disbeliever.'

key_terms.مُدْمِنُ: Habitual drinker / one who makes a habit of

ai.seo_question: What is the status of a habitual wine drinker on the Day of Judgment according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In the context of Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) links habitual wine consumption to a state of *kufr* (disbelief) at the time of death, reflecting the juristic debate between *kufr duna kufr* (lesser disbelief) and major disbelief. It underscores the spiritual gravity of *khamr* beyond mere legal prohibition, emphasizing that persistent indulgence severs one from the fold of faith in the Hereafter.
